statement: Evac shelter A-23 lies just west of the town of Freedom, with a forest to the north-west
The forest north-west of the shelter has huckleberry and blueberry bushes, ferns and a maple tree that needs a drilling tool to tap
Two hostile triffids are far to the north-west of the forest field (about 58-60 tiles); they are slower than the survivor and paralyse with a sting
Locker 1N in the shelter holds a FEMA pamphlet, plastic fork, knife and spoon and a whistle
The smashed north-east locker area has a pipe, 18 scrap metal and 7 small metal sheets on the floor
Pot, clay and cooking recipes need a heat source (oven, stove, kiln or a nearby fire) and the clay pellet recipe accepts clean or murky water
A brazier takes 30 minutes, one sheet metal and a tool with hammering 2 or more, at fabrication 1
The field north-west of the shelter has many rocks, sharp rocks, flint and flaking rock lying around
Murky water pools lie in the field north-west of the shelter and need purification before drinking
A fat zombie and a tough zombie roam the field to the east and south-east of the shelter, and others lurk near western Freedom
A pipe from the destroyed locker was wielded in place of the damaged stick
A makeshift crowbar was crafted from memory at the shelter's east window and is now wielded
Six short strings, four nails, two sheets and a stick lie on the shelter floor by the torn-down east window, and the large rock was dropped there
The survivor is peckish and overweight when heavily loaded

note: Left the shelter through the open north window
Spear recipe shows crafting in the dark is impossible
Crafted the crowbar beside the bright window
Searched pot recipes to pursue renewable water and food
Clay recipe lists clean water in hand as a component
Harland is seen again inside the shelter
Stick was damaged and the pipe is wielded instead
